title.ja: 図1-1 初手▲6八銀が嬉野流の駒組み
title.en: Figure 1-1: Ureshino-style formation with ▲6八銀 on move 1

explain.ja: 嬉野流は、初手▲6八銀から駒組みを進める奇襲戦法の一種で、アマ強豪の嬉野宏明さんが開発し、プロの対局でも採用例があります。奇襲戦法に分類されますが明確な弱点がなく、相手の戦型や先手後手を問わず使えるため非常に優秀な戦法です。指しこなすには独特の感覚が必要で、初心者にはやや難しい戦法です。
explain.en: Ureshino-ryu is a surprise opening that starts with ▲6八銀 on the first move. It was developed by the strong amateur Hiroaki Ureshino and has also been used in professional games. Although classed as a surprise opening, it has no clear weakness and can be used as Black or White against any opponent's setup, so it is a very good opening. It requires a distinctive feel to play well and is somewhat difficult for beginners.

section.ja: 嬉野流の特徴は?初手▲6八銀からの万能奇襲戦法
section.en: What defines the Ureshino school? A versatile surprise opening starting with ▲6八銀

title.ja: 図1-1 初手▲6八銀が嬉野流の駒組み
title.en: Figure 1-1: Ureshino-style formation with ▲6八銀 on move 1

explain.ja: 嬉野流は初手▲6八銀から駒組みをする戦法です。かなり変わった戦法ですが、特別な弱点はない優秀な戦法です。まずは基本の駒組みと攻めの狙いを見ていきましょう。初手に銀を上がるので、初めて見た相手は驚くでしょう。
explain.en: Ureshino-ryu builds its position starting with ▲6八銀 on the first move. It is quite unusual, yet it has no special weakness. First let's look at the basic piece placement and the aims of the attack. An opponent seeing a silver move on the first turn for the first time will be surprised.

explain.ja: 基本の嬉野流は▲7九角と角を引いて使いますが、新嬉野流は角を引くのを保留して駒組みを進めます。他の戦法に切り替えることもできる、新嬉野流の駒組みを学びましょう。嬉野流を指すなら新嬉野流の手順も知っておきたいところです。
explain.en: In standard Ureshino-ryu the bishop is retreated with ▲7九角, but Shin-Ureshino-ryu postpones retreating the bishop while building the position. It allows a switch to other openings, so let's learn its piece placement. If you play Ureshino-ryu, you should know the Shin-Ureshino-ryu moves too.

title.en: Figure 2-1: Ureshino style vs Climbing Silver

explain.ja: 嬉野流は8筋が薄い陣形になるため、相手は棒銀で攻めてくることが多くなります。ここでは嬉野流で棒銀を受ける手順を見ます。かなり独特な受け方で、知らないと指せない手も出てきます。棒銀を指す相手は多いので、この変化は必修です。
explain.en: Ureshino-ryu leaves the 8th file thin, so opponents often attack with Climbing Silver. Here we look at how to meet Climbing Silver. The defense is quite unusual and includes moves you cannot find without knowing them. Many opponents play Climbing Silver, so this line is a must-know.

section.ja: 嬉野流vs棒銀!独特な受けを身に着けよう
section.en: Ureshino school vs Rushing Silver! Master the distinctive defense

title.ja: 図3-1 嬉野流vs四間飛車
title.en: Figure 3-1: Ureshino style vs Fourth File Rook

explain.ja: 嬉野流で四間飛車を相手にするときは、鳥刺しという形で攻めるのが一般的です。鳥刺しの狙いと手順をマスターしておきましょう。特に級位者のアマチュアは四間飛車を指す人が多いので、この指し方はしっかり覚えておきたいところです。
explain.en: Against the Fourth File Ranging Rook, Ureshino-ryu generally attacks with the Torizashi formation. Master its aims and moves. Many amateur kyu-level players use the Fourth File Ranging Rook, so you should learn this well.

section.ja: 嬉野流vs四間飛車!鳥刺し手の攻め筋を知る
section.en: Ureshino school vs Fourth File Rook! Learn the Torisashi attack
